description: This file defines the PimReport class that implements an EndpointAwareReport interface for handling PIM report generation, filtering, and authorization within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages report-related data and interactions, including report header, filter definitions, data retrieval, and access checks.

classes.name: PimReport
classes.description: A class responsible for handling PIM reports, providing header, filter, and data definitions, as well as access control for the report.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PimReport instance with the specified report ID.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Retrieves the ReportGeneratorService instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report based on report ID.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new filter object for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches the report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates filter parameters from the endpoint request.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the report is accessible; throws ForbiddenException if not.
